GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted to last 8 lengths. last turn. ran on strongly # too far back
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 4 lengths. hooked very Wide turn 4 lengths. got going late # start no help
Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down well back 5 lengths. looking for run turn 4 lengths. got out Wide 300 metres. ran on strongly # got up last stride
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. moved up turn looking for run 1 length. got split in Straight . just battled # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up rounding the home turn, and on straightening improved into a narrow run and soon after was contacted on the hindquarter by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. looking for run turn. got to outside in Straight . battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 800m was steadied when racing keenly near the heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back to last 4 lengths. well back turn looking for run. held up down str. ran on strongly late # unlucky again
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up for clear running until after the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. held up in Straight . ran on well when clear # most unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up for clear running until inside the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 6 lengths. last turn. ran on strongly along fence # good from barrier
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Briefly held up for some distance near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. hooked very Wide turn 5 lengths. ran on strongly late # went well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When racing keenly, shifted out off the heels of rnr after passing the 800m. Continued to over-race throughout the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 4 lengths. ran on strongly # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down 5th 5 lengths. got to outside turn 5 lengths. just battled in Straight # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and was hampered soon after by another rnr. On straightening was shifted to the outside of heels to obtain clear running and in doing so made contact with another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & improving slowly 3 Wide from 700m. Four Wide @ 500m & pushed out Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 10W @ 300m & ran on well in last 200m. Just fell short. # Good from rear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Was held up rounding the home turn and in the early part of the straight.
